core_obligations: Show that in both cases the formation of Zbar commutes with etale localization (proof lines 3579-3583).
Reduce to the case of schemes and apply the corresponding lemma (proof lines 3584-3585).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an immersion h : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over S with Z -> X quasi-compact or Z reduced, the morphism Z -> Zbar to the scheme theoretic image is an open immersion identifying Z with a scheme theoretically dense open subspace of Zbar, and Z is even topologically dense in Zbar (source lines 3568-3577). The proof observes that in both cases the formation of Zbar commutes with etale localization, using the quasi-compact and the reduced statements respectively, and then invokes the corresponding lemma for schemes.
